Navbar Snippet Generator

Generate a responsive navbar with mobile hamburger menu — live preview plus HTML, CSS and JS.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter your brand name and links (one per line: "Home|/").
  2. Pick colors, theme and sticky behavior.
  3. Preview it live — resize to see the hamburger.
  4. Copy the code or download the self-contained navbar.html.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What link format do I use?

One per line as Label|/path — e.g. "Pricing|/pricing". If you skip the | part, the link points to "#".

How does the mobile menu work?

Below 768px the links collapse behind a hamburger button; the included JS toggles it with aria-expanded.

Is it accessible?

Yes — the toggle is a real <button> with aria-label and aria-expanded, and the nav uses semantic markup.

Can I make it sticky?

Toggle the sticky option to add position: sticky so the bar stays on top while scrolling.
